rules_name: Commercial Arbitration Rules and Mediation Procedures
rules_version: those applicable under the Rules’ own amendment provisions
tribunal_composition: one neutral arbitrator appointed under the Rules
arbitral_seat: New York, New York, United States
procedure_terms: The Rules govern notices, appointment, hearings, information exchange, and fees. Any change to those procedures requires an agreement permitted by the Rules and applicable law. This clause does not elect a separate optional appellate procedure.
